import json, random, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
# reproduce fuzz generators without triggering their embedded main(): import pieces by exec
fzs = {}
for name in ("fuzz.py", "fuzz2.py", "fuzz3.py"):
    src = open('/workspace/tmp/' + name).read()
    src = src.replace("main()\n", "\n") if name != "fuzz.py" else src
